JourneyDeck

JourneyDeck is an iPhone drive journal. You start each drive yourself. It records that drive, and you can view the route, the photos, and the music for it. There is a Tesla page.

Plus is $39.99/yr.

https://journeydeck.me/
https://journeydeck.me/tesla-drive-journal
https://journeydeck.me/support
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/journeydeck/id6806502526
